name:        useImageMode
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Detects whether an image is predominantly dark or light by sampling pixels via OffscreenCanvas. Uses APCA perceptual lightness (sRGB linearization + power curve) for accurate detection, especially on saturated colors. Runs entirely off the paint path: no visible canvas, no layout thrash. Supports regional sampling for detecting luminance where text overlays will appear. Returns null while loading and falls back gracefully on CORS or network errors.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useImageMode

name:        useTheme
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/theme
description: Programmatic access to theme tokens for non-CSS consumers like SVG, canvas, Vega, D3, maps, or chart libraries that need values in JavaScript instead of CSS custom property references.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTheme

name:        createReorderable
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core
description: Makes a collection's rows reorderable. On a touch screen a finger held still on a row's handle for a moment picks it up (a flick on the handle still scrolls): the row stays in its place, dimmed, while a copy of it follows the finger and an accent line marks where it would land; the other rows stay still, the page scrolls near its edges, and on release the rows rearrange. A pen held still on a handle where the primary pointer is coarse picks the row up as a finger does. A mouse, or a pen where the primary pointer is fine, drags a handle at once the same way, and the rows take their places without motion; a cancelled drag puts everything back at once. Without a drag, the handle toggles reorder mode for its row (a click, Space or Enter): each arrow key moves the row a place at once, and Escape or another activation ends the mode, keeping the moves; screen readers hear each move with the row's place and neighbours, and a hint shows the moves and Done as buttons, for taps alone. The reorder code ships with this function: a collection without the prop loads none of it.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook createReorderable

name:        useCollapsible
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Collapsible
description: Reusable hook that encapsulates the collapsible state machine. Supports three modes: group-controlled (inside CollapsibleGroup), controlled (isOpen + onOpenChange), and uncontrolled (self-managed with defaultIsOpen). Used internally by Card and Section.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCollapsible

name:        useLayer
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layer
description: Core positioning hook for rendering overlay content using CSS Anchor Positioning and the Popover API. Use it as the foundation for custom popovers, hover cards, tooltips, and fixed-position layers when higher-level components are not enough. Both modes use theme body text defaults and end ancestor surface/group membership as a whole, including group-owned state. Explicit props and unrelated contexts remain unchanged. Apply intentional formatting through render styles or content, and establish complete content-local providers inside the rendered layer.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLayer
